title: Proper support after fixed Chow algebraization
statement: Let Z be Noetherian, f : Z → S separated and locally of finite type, q : Y → Z proper, and F a coherent module on Y whose support is proper over S via q ≫ f. Then the support of q_*F is proper over S via f.

proof.text: Unpack hF to obtain the closed support C with properness over S. The pushforward-support lemma gives its closed support D contained in q(C).

Apply the image conjunct of closed_subset_proper_over_base_properties to q and f to obtain a closed set W = q(C) proper over S. Rewrite the support containment as D subset W, then apply the closed-subset conjunct of the same theorem. Package D, its support equality and its properness into HasSupportProperOver.

lean.statement:
theorem chow_algebraization_pushforward_support
    {S Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z]
    (f : Z ⟶ S) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (q : Y ⟶ Z) [IsProper q] (F : CoherentModules Y)
    (hF : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver (q ≫ f) F.obj) :
    Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj F.obj)
